sources.title: UMI Okra Grasping — Lab Subset (Unitree Dex1-1) - claru.ai
sources.snippet: Universal Manipulation Interface hand-held teleoperation data for okra-fruit grasping and harvesting tasks recorded in a lab mock field. Dataset includes RGB video, end-effector 6DOF pose, and gripper width for training Diffusion Policy models on Unitree G1 humanoid robot.
